bait_content.title: Cache Index Sync Required
bait_content.body: Simulated test notice: The browser detected a manifest checksum drift between the service worker asset cache and local storage indices for this site. Stale resources may cause blank components, slow loads, or repeated consent prompts. A cache sync will purge temporary cache entries and revalidate resources from the origin. No passwords or user files are affected. The page may reload during this operation.
